mechanism_narrative: Retail-and-recreation visits in this metro are largely transit-linked, so RETAIL_REC tracks TRANSIT with near-contemporaneous timing. The monotone four-week fall in TRANSIT from -67.1 to -75.6 therefore drags RETAIL_REC further down over the next two weeks rather than plateauing.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from -67.1 to -75.6 across the four snapshot weeks while RETAIL_REC fell from -39.9 to -56.4
failure_condition: In weeks where TRANSIT stays below -70 percent change from baseline, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC equals or exceeds its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When the RESIDENTIAL weekly mean crosses +20 percent above baseline, home-stay compliance has reached a level at which discretionary out-of-home trips are suppressed further. RETAIL_REC therefore falls over the following two weeks as the crossing is sustained.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean crosses above +20 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 18.1 to 23.3 over the four snapshot weeks, crossing +20 in week t-1w
failure_condition: After RESIDENTIAL exceeds +20 percent change from baseline, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is equal to or higher than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Under an active tightening-restrictions regime, workplace closures precede retail closures by roughly one week because retail staffing and daytime demand follow office occupancy. The WORKPLACES drop to -45.6 predicts RETAIL_REC lower over the next single week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean falls more than 5 points versus the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell 6.0 points week-on-week to reach -45.6 in week t-0w
failure_condition: In tightening-restriction weeks following a WORKPLACES drop larger than 5 points, RETAIL_REC rises or is flat week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The joint breach of TRANSIT below -70 and GROCERY_PHARM below -18 removes both commute-anchored and errand-anchored footfall from retail districts at once. The simultaneous breach drives RETAIL_REC lower than either series alone would predict over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below -70 and GROCERY_PHARM below -18 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from -13.0 to -24.1 while TRANSIT fell from -67.1 to -75.6
failure_condition: In weeks where both thresholds are breached, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is equal to or higher than its last-28-day mean, or RETAIL_REC in single-breach weeks is as low as in double-breach weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Late-summer seasonal mean reversion: the -56.4 RETAIL_REC trough sits at the low end of the observed range while the week-on-week decline decelerated from -10.3 to -5.8 points, so RETAIL_REC drifts back up over four weeks as back-to-school and residual outdoor demand returns alongside the PARKS rebound.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC week-on-week change improved from -10.3 to -5.8 points
regime_hint: late-summer seasonal window under tightening restrictions
failure_condition: The next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is equal to or below its last-28-day mean, showing the decelerating decline did not translate into a level rebound.

mechanism_narrative: The 9.0-point week-on-week rebound in PARKS shows households re-accepting out-of-home activity; when this coincides with a flattening RESIDENTIAL series, recreation confidence spills over into discretionary shopping and lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises more than 5 points week-on-week while the RESIDENTIAL week-on-week gain is under 2 points
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL week-on-week gain slowed from 3.6 to 1.6 points
failure_condition: Weeks meeting both conditions are followed by a next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean equal to or below the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: A GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean below -20 marks reduced essential-errand traffic under restriction. Because grocery and pharmacy anchors generate shared trips into retail plazas, the fall of that anchor pulls RETAIL_REC lower over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean falls below -20 percent change from baseline
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM crossed -20 in the final snapshot week at -24.1
failure_condition: Once GROCERY_PHARM is below -20, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is equal to or higher than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In the tightening-restrictions regime the WORKPLACES-to-RESIDENTIAL substitution is the binding constraint on daytime population: with RESIDENTIAL held above +23 and WORKPLACES below -45, retail districts stay drained of daytime footfall for the full four weeks, keeping RETAIL_REC down.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above +23 and WORKPLACES below -45 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL reached 23.3 while WORKPLACES reached -45.6 in week t-0w
failure_condition: With RESIDENTIAL above +23 and WORKPLACES below -45, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is equal to or higher than its last-28-day mean.
